causal_boundary.one_event_rule: one comparable auction event predicts exactly the next comparable event in the same local cell

comparability.transport_rule: Use only the tariff and distance vintage published before the offer cutoff.
comparability.fallback: Restrict to identical delivery location and product standard.
comparability.slash_price_vector: Requires an explicit pre-result class-order map; never average or select a component post hoc.

outcomes.awarded_price_eur_per_m3: positive continuous, modelled on natural-log scale
outcomes.awarded_volume_m3: positive continuous, modelled on natural-log scale
outcomes.unawarded_or_protested: separate categorical state; never coerced to zero or dropped

objective_prior.continuous_outcomes: Jeffreys reference prior p(mu,sigma2) proportional to 1/sigma2 on the local log outcome; no historical 2023-2024 value initializes it.

M0.density: Student-t posterior predictive of prior log transitions, added to the last log outcome
M0.density_support: at least 3 prior transitions and nonzero transition variance

M1.density: Student-t posterior predictive under the Jeffreys reference prior
M1.support: at least 3 prior local observations and nonzero log variance

M2.point: M1 log location plus mean of prior same-phase prequential M1 innovations
M2.phase: exact sorted set of delivery calendar months; distinct month sets never pool
M2.support: M1 estimable plus at least 2 prior nonidentical M1 innovations from the same cell and exact phase
M2.density: numerical convolution of independent M1 and phase-residual Student-t predictives on log scale
M2.integration: tangent transform and adaptive Simpson tolerance 1e-10

weights.jurisdiction: separate for outcome and exact local cell
weights.activation: first target for which M0 M1 and M2 predictive densities were all frozen before the result
weights.update: add each post-result prequential log score only when all three were frozen and estimable on that same target
weights.prediction: softmax of cumulative common-support log evidence

scoring.density: log predictive density on original scale, including the negative-log-outcome Jacobian

posterior_and_Z_post.posterior: append-only local observations, exact phases, and post-adjudication prequential M1 innovations
posterior_and_Z_post.Z_post: model-specific information state containing sufficient statistics, support, adjudication link and common-support evidence; it is not a residual z and not Z-XPL

recovery.resume: Verify the previous sealed manifest, posterior hash and Z_post adjudication link before the next offer; never overwrite a sealed event.
recovery.result_opening_gate: A result body may be opened only after the corresponding immutable prediction freeze exists and its SHA-256 is recorded.
